$comment: The wake fork: an FYI or HANDOFF mail to an idle seat. expect: act or nothing. A body may be {head, pad, tail}.

cases.subject: FYI: staging deploy at 18:00
cases.body: Staging gets the new build at 18:00 today. No action needed; your branch is not in it.

cases.body: The reports job fails since your migration renamed orders.total. Please add a view with the old name or update the job.

cases.subject: HANDOFF: finish the exporter tests

cases.subject: FYI: the totals differ

body.head: Notes for later, nothing to do now.
